description: REEF3D::CORAL drives a CFD body (Z 40 1, fluid_body, two-way): 2D heave decay of a box (0.2 m x 0.15 m, density 500) in a level-set tank, low-storage RK3; the loads of the first stage committed, those of the second at the predicted pose provisional, CORAL steps, the third stage on CORAL's motion; REEF3D_CFD_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL compared.
